core_problem_solved: To provide a standardized API for parsing command-line options passed to a Java application, as part of the Apache Commons suite of reusable components.
key_features: A programmatic API for defining command-line options (flags)
Parsing the `String[] args` array from a `main` method
Querying for the presence of options and their arguments
era_and_niche: One of the original, standard libraries for command-line parsing from the Apache Commons project, widely used in the 2000s.
reason_for_obsolescence: This is a **legacy library**. Its programmatic, non-annotated API is considered verbose and cumbersome compared to modern alternatives. It has been almost entirely superseded in features, ease of use, and popularity by annotation-based libraries, with **`info.picocli:picocli`** being the current de facto industry standard for Java CLI applications.
